question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is '**towards**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] ** __Key Points__ ** 

__
 
• The blank No. 2 in the passage refers to the movement or direction in relation to the forest fire context.
 
• The word "towards" indicates a direction or movement, which fits the sentence logically and contextually.
 
• Other options such as "around," "across," and "through" do not convey the intended meaning in this specific context.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 2**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] ** Additional Information__ ** 

 
• Around (चारों ओर): "Around" indicates surrounding something, which is not the intended meaning in this context.
 
• Across (पार): "Across" means from one side to another, which does not fit the sentence logically.
 
• Through (माध्यम से): "Through" implies passing within something, which is not appropriate for the sentence.
